2014_spells.silence.description: For the duration, no sound can be created within or pass through a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range. Any creature or object entirely inside the sphere is immune to thunder damage, and creatures are deafened while entirely inside it. Casting a spell that includes a verbal component is impossible there.
2014_spells.silence.effectSummary: Make a target deafened until it saves or the spell ends
2014_spells.silence.fullDescription: Using 1 action, for the duration, no sound can be created within or pass through a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range. Any creature or object entirely inside the sphere is immune to thunder damage, and creatures are deafened while entirely inside it; Casting a spell that includes a verbal component is impossible there. The effect lasts for up to 10 minutes; you must concentrate, and the effect ends if your concentration ends; you can cast it as a ritual.
